# Community Rule Column 8 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 8 | **Condition:** complete

---

**1** In the council of the community there shall be twelve men and three priests who are perfect in all

**2** that has been revealed from the whole Torah, practicing truth and righteousness

**3** and justice and covenant-faithfulness and humility, each man with his neighbor,

**4** to preserve faithfulness in the land with steadfast purpose and a broken spirit, and to atone for

**5** sin by practicing justice and enduring the affliction of the refining furnace, and to walk with all by the measure of

**6** truth and by the regulation of the time. When these exist in Israel,

**7** the council of the community shall be established in truth as an eternal planting,

**8** a holy house for Israel, and a foundation of the holy of

**9** holies for Aaron — true witnesses for judgment, chosen by the will of God to atone

**10** for the land and to render to the wicked their recompense. This is the tested wall,

**11** the precious cornerstone whose foundations shall not shake nor

**12** be moved from their place — a dwelling of the holy of holies

**13** for Aaron with knowledge for all, for a covenant of justice and to offer a pleasing fragrance, and a house of

**14** perfection and truth in Israel to establish a covenant according to the everlasting statutes. They shall be accepted to atone

**15** for the land and to determine judgment against wickedness, and injustice shall be no more. When these have been established

**16** in the foundation of the community for two years with perfection of way, they shall be set apart as holy

**17** within the council of the men of the community. Every matter hidden from Israel that has been found

**18** by the one who searches — he shall not conceal it from them out of fear of a spirit of

**19** apostasy. When these things come to pass in the community in Israel according to these

**20** regulations, they shall be separated from the midst of the habitation of the men of injustice to go

**21** to the wilderness to prepare there the way of the LORD, as it is written:

**22** "In the wilderness prepare the way of the LORD; make straight in the desert a highway

**23** for our God." This is the study of the Torah which he commanded through Moses, to act

**24** according to all that has been revealed from time to time, and as the prophets revealed by his Holy

**25** Spirit. Every man from the men of the community, the covenant of

**26** the community, who turns aside from any commandment deliberately — he shall not touch the pure food of

**27** the men of holiness, nor shall he have knowledge of any of their counsel until his deeds are purified from all injustice.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 8 is the foundational charter of the community's inner council. The citation of Isaiah 40:3 (lines 21-23) is interpreted as a mandate for Torah study in the wilderness. The temple imagery ("holy of holies," "eternal planting," "cornerstone") reflects the community's self-understanding as a living temple replacing the Jerusalem cult.*
